items.exampleEn: A panel of teachers chose the new textbooks for next year.
items.exampleZh: 一個由老師組成的小組選出了明年的新課本。

items.exampleEn: This hotel employs staff who speak five languages.
items.exampleZh: 這家飯店僱用會說五種語言的員工。

items.exampleEn: The tourism sector grew quickly after the new airport opened.
items.exampleZh: 新機場啟用後，觀光產業成長得很快。

items.exampleEn: My first employer was a small bakery near my school.
items.exampleZh: 我的第一個僱主是學校附近的一家小麵包店。

items.exampleEn: As a travel consultant, she plans trips for busy families.
items.exampleZh: 身為旅遊顧問，她替忙碌的家庭規劃旅程。

items.exampleEn: The deputy mayor opened the new library.
items.exampleZh: 副市長為新圖書館揭幕。

items.exampleEn: The magazine published a short profile of the young chef.
items.exampleZh: 那本雜誌刊登了一篇那位年輕廚師的簡短介紹。

items.exampleEn: The machine operator wears special gloves for safety.
items.exampleZh: 機器操作員為了安全戴著特殊手套。

items.sentenceEn: She was employed as a tour guide for two summers.
items.sentenceZh: 她曾受僱當了兩個暑假的導遊。

items.audioEn: Please hold the line; the operator will connect you to the sales department.
items.audioZh: 請稍候，接線生會幫您轉接到業務部。
items.questionZh: 接線生會幫來電者轉接到哪裡？

items.sentenceEn: I updated my online profile with a new photo and my latest job.
items.sentenceZh: 我用新照片和最近的工作更新了我的網路個人檔案。

items.sentenceEn: While the manager is on holiday, her deputy will make the decisions.
items.sentenceZh: 經理休假期間，由她的副手做決定。

items.stemEn: The city formed a ____ of experts to study the traffic problem.
items.stemZh: 市政府成立了一個專家小組來研究交通問題。

items.stemEn: The company hired an outside ____ to give advice on cutting costs.
items.stemZh: 公司請了一位外部顧問，針對削減成本提供建議。

items.passageEn: Linda worked in the banking sector for ten years before she became a consultant. Now she helps small companies plan their future. Last month, a large hotel group asked her to join a panel of judges for a business contest. Before the event, she read the profile of every team. The winning team had invented a simple machine that helps hotel cleaners carry heavy sheets, and its operator can control it with one hand. After the contest, the hotel group's deputy director offered the team a contract. Linda believes a good employer should welcome new ideas, and companies that employ young inventors often grow faster. The contest has become quite prestigious.
items.passageZh: Linda 在銀行業工作了十年，之後成為一名顧問，現在協助小公司規劃未來。上個月，一家大型飯店集團邀請她加入一場商業比賽的評審團。比賽前，她讀了每一個參賽隊伍的簡介。獲勝的隊伍設計出一台簡單的機器，能幫飯店清潔人員搬運沉重的床單，操作員只要用一隻手就能控制它。比賽結束後，飯店集團的副主任給了這個隊伍一份合約。Linda 認為，好的僱主應該歡迎新點子，而僱用年輕發明家的公司往往成長得更快。這場比賽現在已經相當有聲望了。

questions.questionZh: 比賽前 Linda 做了什麼準備？
options: 讀了每一個參賽隊伍的簡介

items.promptZh: 我的僱主每年提供員工兩週的訓練。
referenceEn: My employer gives employees two weeks of training every year.
Every year, my employer provides two weeks of training for its staff.
rubricZh: 「兩週的訓練」可寫，例如 two weeks of training、a two-week training 等
說每年的情況，時態配合內容（例如 gives、provides 等）

items.promptZh: 這個國家的科技業提供了很多工作機會。
referenceEn: The technology sector in this country provides many jobs.
This country's technology sector offers lots of job opportunities.
rubricZh: 「科技業」可寫，例如 the technology sector、the tech sector 等
「提供很多工作機會」可寫，例如 provides many jobs、offers lots of job opportunities 等
時態可用現在式或現在完成式（例如 provides、has created 等）
